steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are these... even Corruptors anymore? They don't die wherever you strike them, the parts just keep growing back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha... Haha, and they have solidarity too.

Rusty contamination is leaking out and expanding at a shocking rate, corrupting the physical space in which the statue stands. The entire place is soaked in the mental contamination of the Ring Master, and you who don't obey her will are the real intruders.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Oh... Is this the power of the Black Ring? All is decided by the Ring's owner. She can control everything inside the Ring.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: A battle like this has no end. They don't know death.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then how are we supposed to fight them?! Can we go back?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The way back is blocked too. This statue has been completely derailed from reality.

options: Keep going up and break through. That's the only way!
